testCase.name: [dev] S07 Same-day re-processing, both modes: unchanged text does not bring back a deleted extracted row or task; dictating it again does

descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S07 「同一天重新处理，两种模式：文字没变不会带回删掉的提取行或任务；重新口述会带回来」 Same-day re-processing, both modes: unchanged text does not bring back a deleted extracted row or task; dictating it again does

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U3 A deleted medication row, task or Important Point does not reappear on the next day's processing (or any later processing) unless the physician dictates it again.（UAT TC-24；TFA-94699 AC 5；TFA-92590 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U10 Every TC-24 rule holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home, including deleting a Nursing Home resident.（UAT 3.3；UAT TC-24）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Fresh physician. Hospital patient with one kept row 'Apixaban 5 mg PO BID' and one kept task; Nursing Home resident with one kept row 'Donepezil 10 mg PO nightly' and one kept task

When Hospital: type a pre-round text that names a drug and a task, Save Note, delete the extracted row and task, press Save Note again without changing the text, then replace the text with a new sentence that dictates both again and Save Note. Nursing Home: the same with the visit text and Save & Extract.

Then After the unchanged re-processing the deleted row and task are not back (held: Q3). After the new dictation they are back, because the physician dictated them again. Kept rows and tasks stay throughout.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：TFA-94699 AC 5 ('never comes back unless re-dictated'). cp1, cp2, cp7 and cp8 are preconditions: if the extraction did not create the row and the task, the run is Invalid. Unchanged re-processing (cp3, cp4, cp9, cp10): must not contain the deleted row or task, with the kept row or task as positive control; …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S07 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-24.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：AICHECK · AI 输出检查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
